text: Mariana transformed our raw PostgreSQL data into a powerful churn prediction model. Using Python and dbt, she built a clean pipeline in BigQuery that reduced our false positives by 15%. The Power BI dashboard she created is now the single source of truth for our CS team. Highly recommended for data-heavy SaaS environments.

Excellent work on our LTV modeling. Mariana didn't just build a dashboard; she questioned our attribution logic and suggested a multi-touch model that revealed underperforming channels. Her SQL queries were optimized for speed, and the final Tableau report was intuitive for non-technical stakeholders. Worth every penny.

Mariana handled our migration from Redshift to BigQuery with precision. The dbt governance setup she implemented has significantly reduced our data incidents. The only minor drawback was a slight delay in the final documentation, but her technical expertise in SQL and Python more than made up for it. A solid professional.

We needed real-time visibility into ad spend, and Mariana delivered a Power BI dashboard that updates every 5 minutes. Her use of Python for data cleaning ensured our metrics were accurate. This project directly helped us cut wasted ad spend by 12% in the first quarter. Fast, reliable, and technically sharp.

Building a loan default risk scoring system requires high accuracy and explainability. Mariana used Python to train models that are both robust and interpretable for our compliance team. The BigQuery integration was flawless. Her attention to detail in the SQL layer prevented several potential data integrity issues. Top tier.

Mariana helped us understand our RevPAR better than our previous vendor. The Tableau dashboard she built allowed our regional managers to compare occupancy trends across 40 locations. While the initial setup took a bit longer than expected due to legacy data cleaning, the final product was worth the wait.

Our supply chain delays were costing us millions. Mariana’s Python-based prediction model helped us anticipate bottlenecks 48 hours in advance. The Power BI integration allowed our ops team to reroute shipments dynamically. Her ability to translate complex logistics data into actionable insights is rare. A true expert.

The downtime analysis was technically sound, but communication was lacking. Mariana is an excellent Python developer and her SQL queries were efficient, but she often sent updates that were too technical for our plant managers. We needed more plain-language summaries. The dashboard is good, but the collaboration process could be improved.

Cart abandonment was our biggest headache. Mariana dug into our BigQuery logs and identified a specific UX issue in our checkout flow that we had missed. Her dbt models cleaned the data beautifully. The final Tableau dashboard is now used daily by our product team. I couldn't be happier with the results.

Mariana built a retention model that helped us identify at-risk students early. Her use of Python for statistical analysis was rigorous, and the Power BI visuals made the data accessible to our academic deans. She was patient with our non-technical questions and delivered on time. A great fit for the education sector.

The document search feature Mariana developed saved our associates hours of manual review. The underlying SQL architecture is scalable and fast. While the initial prediction accuracy was slightly lower than promised, she iterated quickly and improved the model within two weeks. Professional and responsive.

We needed to understand our donor lifecycle, and Mariana delivered a clear, impactful dashboard. Her Python scripts automated the data cleaning process, saving us significant staff time. The Power BI report helped us double our repeat donation rate in six months. She truly cares about the mission behind the data.

Reducing patient no-shows is critical for our clinic’s efficiency. Mariana’s scheduling optimization model, built with Python and dbt, reduced no-shows by 20%. The BigQuery integration ensures our data is always up-to-date. Her work has had a direct, positive impact on patient care and revenue. Highly professional.

Mariana’s market trend analysis gave us a competitive edge in our portfolio valuation. Her SQL expertise allowed us to query large datasets quickly, and the Tableau dashboard made it easy to present our findings to investors. She is detail-oriented and delivers high-quality work consistently. I would hire her again immediately.

The SLA monitoring dashboard Mariana built has streamlined our support operations. Her use of Python to classify tickets automatically has reduced our response time by 30%. The Power BI visuals are clean and easy to use. She was a great communicator throughout the project and delivered before the deadline. Outstanding work.
